final: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), total_and_count AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_telescopes, COUNT(*) as num_statuses FROM status_counts), status_shares AS (SELECT cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / CAST(tac.total_telescopes AS REAL) as share, 1.0 / CAST(tac.num_statuses AS REAL) as avg_share FROM status_counts, total_and_count tac), above_avg_statuses AS (SELECT cnt, share, share - avg_share as excess FROM status_shares WHERE share > avg_share) SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_telescopes_above_avg, AVG(share) as avg_share_above_avg, AVG(excess) as avg_excess_above_avg FROM above_avg_statuses
